title: FIELD Governance Manifest
description: Spin State Labs FIELD v1 governance manifest for a single agentic AI deployment. Every FIELD-governed agent carries exactly one manifest. All five sections (Federated, Identity, Enforcement, Ledger, Delegation) are required. Critical-gap rules: no kill switch, no delegation grantor, or an unsealed ledger make a manifest INVALID.

schema_version.description: Pins the manifest to a FIELD schema version.

federated.description: F — rules for operating across ownership/trust boundaries.

isolated.description: true = this agent federates with no external peers. An explicit declaration, never left undeclared.

trust_basis.description: How this peer is authenticated/authorized, e.g. mTLS cert, signed capability token, shared registry entry.

identity.description: I — attribution and sovereignty. Whose agent this is, under what authority and jurisdiction.

principal.description: The human or organizational principal this agent represents. An agent without a principal is a sovereignty violation.

jurisdiction.description: Regulatory regimes governing operation, e.g. SOX, GDPR, PIPEDA, EU-AI-Act.

enforcement.description: E — the brakes and rails. Runtime constraints that stop the agent leaving its authorized envelope.

kill_switch.description: How a human halts this agent mid-action. Its absence is a critical gap.

endpoint.description: Where the halt signal is sent.

method.description: How the halt is triggered, e.g. HTTP POST, signal, queue message.

on_breach.description: Action when the cap is hit, e.g. halt, escalate.

escalation_triggers.description: Conditions under which the agent stops and defers to a human.

irreversible_action_policy.description: How one-way actions (transfers, deletes, sends) are governed.

ledger.description: L — the immutable audit trail. Cryptographic sealing is baseline, not optional.

cryptographic_seal.description: MUST be true. An unsealed ledger is a critical gap.

seal_algorithm.description: The tamper-evidence scheme. 'none' is not permitted.

retention_days.description: How long ledger entries are retained. Regulated agents typically require 2555 (7 years).

logged_events.description: What is written to the ledger, e.g. every action, every escalation, every delegation use, every spend.

store.description: Where the ledger lives, e.g. append-only store, WORM bucket, on-chain anchor.

delegation.description: D — the authorization chain from a human principal to this autonomous agent.

granted_by.description: Who authorized this agent to act. Its absence means the agent has no legitimate authority — a critical gap.

scope.description: The specific actions this agent is authorized to perform.

expiry.description: When the delegation lapses (ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2027-01-01 or 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z). Standing grants use a far-future date and must be reviewed. Past or near-term expiry is a validator warning.

runtime_protocol.description: Recommended: the runtime prompt protocol applied during operation. FIELD wraps FORCE.
